# Rashid Yousufzai — Portfolio (https://rashidyousufzai.netlify.app)

## Summary
Rashid Yousufzai is a Full Stack Developer based in Karachi, Pakistan. He builds production web applications with the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js), Laravel and WordPress sites, custom Shopify apps, and AI-assisted features using OpenAI and LangChain. He has 3+ years of professional experience across product teams and agencies.
